title: PI-26b: record an overlap marker with its cause and say it in the checkpoint
outcome: When TermAl marks an open check as overlapped, it records why: the marking session, its command and the reason (a lost shell's places, anywhere, a running command in the check's worktree, a turn start). It says so in the checkpoint's observation, in the evidence summary, and in a host line to the check's agent, so an unknown outcome names its cause.
acceptance: An overlap marker is recorded with its cause (the marking session and command) and said in the checkpoint, so an unknown outcome names why.
